name: Name
renameHint: The trigger viewers type in chat. Renaming keeps the response and settings.
responsePlaceholder: What the bot replies… insert variables below.
linesHint: Up to {max} lines; each line is sent as its own chat message.
fallbackHint: Add | and some text inside any variable for a default when it comes back empty: {touser|everyone}.
restrictPlaceholder: Twitch user ID. Only they can run it
bumpCounterHint: Adds one to this counter every time the command runs successfully.
moduleVariableRequires: Requires {module} enabled. Adding this variable does not enable the module.
moduleVariableContext: Event-only values are empty without a matching event. The preview uses sample data.
lineOver: Line {n} is over the limit: {len} of {max} characters.
lineNear: Line {n} is close to the limit: {len} of {max} characters.
linesCapped: {n} of {max} messages. Remove one to add another.
